about_short_description.short_description: Island offers an enterprise browser that enhances security and productivity by integrating essential tools.

product.name: The Island Enterprise Platform
product.description: An enterprise work platform that combines browser-based access, security controls, AI governance, endpoint protection, and network access in a unified management environment.

product.name: The Enterprise Browser
product.description: A Chromium-based browser with built-in enterprise access controls, data loss prevention, threat protection, activity visibility, productivity tools, and policy management.

product.name: Enterprise AI
product.description: An enterprise AI capability that governs the use of AI tools by applying access, visibility, and data protection controls within the work environment.

product.name: Enterprise Network
product.description: A SASE-based network access service that provides zero-trust connectivity, secure web access, and traffic protection for enterprise users and applications.

product.name: Island Extension
product.description: A browser extension that adds enterprise data protection, secure access, AI governance, and activity visibility to Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari, and other Chromium-based browsers.

product.name: Island Desktop
product.description: An endpoint security agent for Windows and macOS that provides zero-trust access, endpoint data protection, device visibility, web filtering, and activity monitoring.
